unreadable.description: Set only if the file could not be read as text (e.g. a binary .docx with no converter available). Name the file and why.

codePaths.description: Directories or files holding the implementation these documents describe.

force.description: mandatory for MUST/NEVER/ALWAYS; descriptive for prose that states what the system does

checkable.description: what would have to be true of the code for this to hold, in one line

role.description: what this line does for the requirement

result.description: e.g. "3 hits, all in tests" or "0 hits"

reasoning.description: why this verdict and not the adjacent one
